leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a TypeScript interface to define the structure of sessionStorage wrapper methods
Construct a class that encapsulates sessionStorage operations with type safety
Apply TypeScript generics to create flexible get and set methods for various data types
Initialize and configure the wrapper to handle JSON serialization and deserialization
Integrate the typed wrapper into a simple script to demonstrate its usage
Manipulate sessionStorage data using the wrapper's methods to store and retrieve typed values
Control data integrity by implementing error handling for parsing and storage failures
